_comment: Two-tier coverage gate (ADR-0009). `targets` are the goals every package must reach by milestone M6. `packages` holds per-package gates = measured coverage (percent), added when a package is created and only ever raised. AI tools: never let actual coverage fall below a package gate; document unavoidable exceptions (e.g. generated code) here.
_measured: Percent of statements + branches, `pytest --cov=app` over unit and integration tests (needs `make up`). Gates are floored measurements and only ratchet up.
